title: JA Donate 1.0.5 is pinned end to end: contract in the tree naming the published archive and Claude Cowork for Joomla 0.24.26, maxVersion 1.0.5, every Joomla quickstart pinned on 0.24.26 in both catalogues
steps: S1: Read packages/cms/tracy-joomla-quickstart/contracts/ja-donate/j6/1.0.5/*, 1.0.5.design.json, 1.0.5.copy.json, packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/templates/joomla-ja-donate.json and both quickstarts.json catalogues.
expect: S1: the five contract files exist; manifest id ja-donate/j6/1.0.5, quickstart version 1.0.5 of quickstart/ja-donate/j6, webroot ja-donate-j6-webroot-1.0.5.tar.gz with sha256 8d447a0d…6746d6 (the published asset), coworkContractVersion 0.24.26; maxVersion 1.0.5 not below minVersion, maxVersionNote names 1.0.5; every Joomla pin in apps/tracy-web/src/quickstarts.json is 0.24.26 or newer and the provision copy pins the same.

evidence: Before this PR the Design system door stopped at 1.0.4 (TEMPLATE_VERSION_UNCHECKED for a site built from 1.0.5) and no Claude Cowork pin carried the 1.0.5 contract
fence: The 1.0.5 default look is the released 1.0.4 one: 0 computed differences at desktop and phone, 29/29 pages as released (VERIFICATION.json on the release)
